name: Flower Mound Town Center
summary: Flower Mound Town Center is a Kroger-anchored neighborhood shopping center offering convenient access to groceries, health and beauty services, dining, and specialty retail. Located at Cross Timbers Road and Long Prairie Road, this community hub serves Flower Mound residents with a diverse mix of essential services and popular brands.
demographics: Flower Mound Town Center serves an affluent suburban family demographic in one of Texas's most desirable communities, with median household incomes significantly above the national average. The primary trade area attracts upper-middle-class families with children, professionals aged 30-55, and active retirees who value convenience and quality. Shoppers typically seek one-stop shopping experiences combining grocery needs with health, beauty, and dining services, reflecting the busy lifestyles of dual-income households in this rapidly growing Dallas-Fort Worth suburb.
description: Flower Mound Town Center is a neighborhood shopping destination strategically located at the southwest corner of Cross Timbers Road and Long Prairie Road in Flower Mound, Texas. This Kroger-anchored community center serves as a convenient hub for local residents, offering everything needed for daily life in one accessible location. The center features a carefully curated mix of essential services and popular retailers, including European Wax Center, Palm Beach Tan, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Banfield Pet Hospital, Blissful Bark Dog Wash, and VIO Med Spa. Whether visitors need groceries for dinner, health and beauty services, or a fresh meal out, Flower Mound Town Center delivers a comprehensive shopping and dining experience. The center's strong tenant lineup and prime location make it an integral part of the Flower Mound community, providing the perfect blend of small businesses, local shops, and favorite retail brands all in your backyard.
